The current passing through a conducting loop in the form of equilateral triangle of side $4\sqrt{3}$ cm is 2 A. The magnetic field at its centroid is $\alpha \times 10^{-5}$ T. The value of $\alpha$ is _________.
(Given : $\mu_{0} = 4\pi \times 10^{-7}$ SI units)

Two short dipoles (A, B), A having charges $\pm 2\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ and length 1 cm and B having charges $\pm 4\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ and length 1 cm are placed with their centres 80 cm apart as shown in the figure. The electric field at a point P, equi-distant from the centres of both dipoles is _______ N/C.

Suppose a long solenoid of 100 cm length, radius 2 cm having 500 turns per unit length, carries a current $I = 10 \sin(\omega t)$ A, where $\omega = 1000\ \mathrm{rad/s}$. A circular conducting loop (B) of radius 1 cm is coaxially slided through the solenoid at a speed $v = 1\ \mathrm{cm/s}$. The r.m.s. current through the loop when the coil B is inserted 10 cm inside the solenoid is $\frac{\alpha}{\sqrt{2}}\ \mu\mathrm{A}$. The value of $\alpha$ is ______.
[Resistance of the loop $= 10\ \Omega$]
questions.solution:
$n = 500, I = 10\sin(1000t);$
Assuming the solenoid to be infinitely long :
$\phi = BA = \mu_{0}nI \cdot \pi r^{2} \Rightarrow e = -\frac{d\phi}{dt} = -\mu_{0}n\pi r^{2}.\frac{dI}{dt}$
induced current $= i = \frac{e}{R} = \frac{\mu_{0}n\pi r^{2}}{R} \cdot 10 \times 1000 \times \cos(1000t)$
$i_{rms} = \frac{i_{0}}{\sqrt{2}} = 197.4 \simeq 197$

questions.stem: To compare EMF of two cells using potentiometer the balancing lengths obtained are 200 cm and 150 cm. The least count of scale is 1 cm. The percentage error in the ratio of EMFs is ________.

A circular loop of radius 7 cm is placed in uniform magnetic field of 0.2 T directed perpendicular to plane of loop. The loop is converted into a square loop in 0.5 s. The EMF induced in the loop is _______ mV.
questions.solution:
$e = \frac{B\Delta A}{\Delta t}; 2\pi r = 4\ell \Rightarrow \ell = \pi r/2$
$A_{i} = \pi r^{2}, \quad A_{f} = \ell^{2} = \pi^{2}r^{2}/4$
$e = \frac{B\left(\pi r^{2} - \pi^{2}r^{2}/4\right)}{0.5} = -1.32\ \mathrm{mV}$

One mole of an ideal diatomic gas expands from volume V to 2V isothermally at a temperature $27^\circ$ C and does W joule of work. If the gas undergoes same magnitude of expansion adiabatically from $27^\circ$ C doing the same amount of work W, then its final temperature will be (close to) ________ $^\circ$C.
($\log_{e}2 = 0.693$)
questions.solution:
$W = nRT\,\ell n\frac{V_{2}}{V_{1}}$
$= 1 \times R \times 300\,\ell n\left(\frac{2V}{V}\right)$
For adiabatic process : $\Delta Q = 0 = \Delta U + \Delta W$
$\Rightarrow \Delta U = -W = -R \times 300\,\ell n 2$
$nC_{v}\Delta T = -R \times 300 \times \ell n 2$
$\Rightarrow 1 \times \frac{5R}{2} \times \Delta T = -R \times 300 \times \ell n 2$
$\Rightarrow \Delta T = -83.16^\circ\mathrm{C}$
final temperature $= 27 - 83 = -56^\circ\mathrm{C}$

questions.stem: Two charges $7\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ and $-2\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ are placed at $(-9, 0, 0)$ cm and $(9, 0, 0)$ cm respectively in an external field $E = \frac{A}{r^{2}}\hat{r}$, where $A = 9 \times 10^{5}\ \mathrm{N/C.m^{2}}$. Considering the potential at infinity is 0, the electrostatic energy of the configuration is ________J.
questions.solution:
The given electric field is produced by a point charge placed at origin :
$\vec{E} = \frac{kq}{r^{2}}\hat{r} = \frac{A}{r^{2}} \cdot \hat{r} \Rightarrow q = 10^{-4}\ \mathrm{c}$
$U = \frac{k \times 7 \times 10^{-6} \times 10^{-4}}{0.09} - \frac{k \times 2 \times 10^{-6} \times 10^{-4}}{0.09} - \frac{k \times 7 \times 2 \times 10^{-12}}{2 \times 0.09}$
$= 49.3\ \mathrm{J}$

questions.stem:
An air bubble of volume $2.9\ \mathrm{cm^{3}}$ rises from the bottom of a swimming pool of 5 m deep. At the bottom of the pool water temperature is $17\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. The volume of the bubble when it reaches the surface, where the water temperature is $27\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, is ________ $\mathrm{cm^{3}}$.
($g = 10\ \mathrm{m/s^{2}}$, density of water $= 10^{3}\ \mathrm{kg/m^{3}}$, and 1 atm pressure is $10^{5}$ Pa)

The internal energy of a monotomic gas is 3nRT. One mole of helium is kept in a cylinder having internal cross section area of $17\ \mathrm{cm^{2}}$ and fitted with a light movable frictionless piston. The gas is heated slowly by suppling 126 J heat. If the temperature rises by $4\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, then the piston will move ______ cm.
(atmospheric pressure $= 10^{5}$ Pa)
questions.solution:
$U = 3nRT \Rightarrow \Delta U = 3nR\Delta T = 3 \times 1 \times R \times 4 = 12R$
$W = Q - \Delta U = 126 - 12 \times 8.314 = P\Delta V$
$\Delta V = \frac{26.232}{10^{5}} = A \times h = 17 \times 10^{-4} \times h$
$\Rightarrow h = 0.1543\ \mathrm{m} = 15.43\ \mathrm{cm}$

questions.stem: A parallel plate capacitor with plate separation 5 mm is charged by a battery. On introducing a mica sheet of 2 mm and maintaining the connections of the plates with the terminals of the battery, it is found that it draws 25% more charge from the battery. The dielectric constant of mica is ________.
questions.solution:
$C_{0} = \frac{\varepsilon_{0}A}{5} \quad C = \frac{\varepsilon_{0}A}{5 - 2 + \frac{2}{K}}$
$\Delta q = V \cdot \Delta C$
$0.25 \times q_{0} = V\left(C - C_{0}\right) \Rightarrow 0.25 \times C_{0} \cdot V = V\left(C - C_{0}\right)$
$\Rightarrow 1.25C_{0} = C \Rightarrow 1.25 \times \frac{\varepsilon_{0}A}{5} = \frac{\varepsilon_{0}A}{5 - 2 + \frac{2}{K}}$
$\Rightarrow K = 2$

When an unpolarized light falls at a particular angle on a glass plate (placed in air), it is observed that the reflected beam is linearly polarized. The angle of refracted beam with respect to the normal is _____.
($\tan^{-1}(1.52) = 57.7^\circ$, refractive indices of air and glass are 1.00 and 1.52, respectively.)
The velocity of sound in air is doubled when the temperature is raised from $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ to $\alpha\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. The value of $\alpha$ is _______.

A ball of radius r and density $\rho$ dropped through a viscous liquid of density $\sigma$ and viscosity $\eta$ attains its terminal velocity at time t, given by $t = A\rho^{a}r^{b}\eta^{c}\sigma^{d}$, where A is a constant and a, b, c and d are integers. The value of $\frac{b+c}{a+d}$ is ________.
questions.solution:
$t = A \cdot \rho^{a}r^{b}\eta^{c}\sigma^{d}$
$\Rightarrow T = \left(ML^{-3}\right)^{a+d} \cdot L^{b} \cdot \left(ML^{-1}T^{-1}\right)^{c}$
$T = M^{a+d+c} \cdot L^{-3a-3d+b-c} \cdot T^{-c}$
$a + d + c = 0$ .....(1)
$3a + 3d - b + c = 0$ .....(2)
$-c = 1$ .....(3)
solving (1), (2) & (3) : $a + d = 1, b = 2, c = -1$
$\frac{b+c}{a+d} = \frac{2-1}{1} = 1$

questions.stem:
The average energy released per fission for the nucleus of ${}^{235}_{92}\mathrm{U}$ is 190 MeV. When all the atoms of 47 g pure ${}^{235}_{92}\mathrm{U}$ undergo fission process, the energy released is $\alpha \times 10^{23}$ MeV. The value of $\alpha$ is ______.
(Avogadro Number $= 6 \times 10^{23}$ per mole)
The size of the images of an object, formed by a thin lens are equal when the object is placed at two different positions 8 cm and 24 cm from the lens. The focal length of the lens is _______ cm.
questions.solution:
$|m| = \frac{f}{|u - f|}$
one case $\rightarrow u = 8$, other case : $u = 24$
in the two eases magnitude of magnification will be equal :
$\frac{f}{f - 8} = \frac{f}{24 - f} \Rightarrow f = 16\ \mathrm{cm}$

questions.stem: Suppose there is a uniform circular disc of mass M kg and radius r m shown in figure. The shaded regions are cut out from the disc. The moment of inertia of the remainder about the axis A of the disc is given by $\frac{x}{256}Mr^{2}$. The value of x is _______.
questions.solution:
mass of removed disc $= m = \frac{M}{\pi r^{2}}\left(\pi\left(\frac{r}{4}\right)^{2}\right)$
$= M/16$
moment of inatia of removed disc
$= I_{1} = I_{cm} + mx^{2} = \frac{m(r/4)^{2}}{2} + m(3r/4)^{2}$
moment of inentia of original disc $= I = \frac{Mr^{2}}{2}$
$= I - 2I_{1}$
$= \frac{Mr^{2}}{2} - 2I_{1} = \frac{109Mr^{2}}{256}$
Ans $\rightarrow 109$
